patch_list: Patches libAura.so CLicenseInterface::CheckLicenses so licence records never expire, and strips the 'Premium: N days left' countdown from all language files.
Experimental: forces Sygic Truck store/billing checks to true (isBillingSupported, buyDone, StoreIsEnabled/Supported, sidebar license).
